delivered.statement: Record INR37,000 crores AUM added; 5 million new customers acquired in Q1
Profit grew 28% YoY; ROE 20.4%, ROA 4.7% despite BHFL dilution impact
Gold loan grew 112% YoY, now 4% of AUM; rural/urban PL grew 49%/38%
Loan loss ratio improved to 1.54% from 1.87%; Stage 2+3 down to 1.87% from 1.94%
Deposit book reached INR68,500 crores, now represents 15% of balance sheet
27 AI bots live; 45 million customer interactions analyzed; 71% DIY service volume handled by AI

themes: FinAI transformation—AI unit expanding 230 to 400 people; 27 bots live; agentic apps deploying
Gold loan momentum—112% growth, 2,700-3,000 branch target, 25% digital contribution, self-employed focus
Digital platform acceleration—INR50k crores FY26, INR100k FY27, AI-driven customer acquisition
Credit quality structural improvement—loan loss 1.54%, Stage 2/3 declining, provision strengthening
Consumer pricing power—SKU prices up 20% in durables; 38-49% growth in consumer finance
Opex efficiency via AI—targeting 25-40 bps improvement; voice bot cost 1/3 human labor
risks: Monsoon coverage incomplete; West Asia geopolitical crisis inflationary risk to credit quality
AI infrastructure costs scaling with adoption; token costs monitored as usage accelerates
Cost of funds creeping higher on inflation pressures; range-bound but with upward bias expected
Gold price sensitivity—business denominator shrinks below $2,500; lending segment competitive intensity intensifying

analyst_pushback.question: Raise FY27 guidance given strong Q1 AUM/profit beat?
analyst_pushback.response: One solo doesn't make summer; waiting one more quarter to confirm momentum before revising

analyst_pushback.question: Why INR300 crore macroeconomic provision in strong quarter?
analyst_pushback.response: Strengthening balance sheet resilience, bulletproofing against VUCA world; long-term sustainability priority over short-term ROE

analyst_pushback.question: Will structural credit improvement lead to yield compression industry-wide?
analyst_pushback.response: Not macro-focused; chose to be lowest-risk company; our thresholds 30-40% of industry DPD levels

analyst_pushback.question: How control opex with AI cost surge amid scaling?
analyst_pushback.response: AI cost benchmarked at <1/3 human labor; use open-source models, flash mini-models, not full LLMs

tone_evidence: Called Q1 'excellent' with 'all engines firing'; repeatedly deferred guidance revision, stating 'wait one more quarter' shows disciplined caution.
